title: Simple syrups
hook: Sugar and water. *Double the sugar*, a richer syrup.
cover_text: Sugar and water, *two syrups* for two jobs

dishes.name: Simple syrup
dishes.text: *Equal weights*, stirred until clear. Sweetens iced tea and lemonade.

dishes.name: Rich syrup
dishes.text: *Twice the sugar*: thicker and sweeter, so a cocktail needs less of it.

sources: https://jeffreymorgenthaler.com/2006/simple-syrup/ (measure sugar and water by weight; uses 2:1 rich simple syrup)
https://www.diffordsguide.com/encyclopedia/3593/cocktails/2-to-1-rich-sugar-syrup-versus-1-to-1-simple-syrup (1:1 simple vs 2:1 rich syrup; rich is sweeter, less dilution)
